summary: A standalone, responsive landing page for Ibrahim Fxtrader Academy, an online forex trading education business. It uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no backend, data storage, or user accounts.

questions.question: Describe the features for Ibrahim Fxtrader Academy Landing Page.
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive single-page academy marketing site with header navigation and Get started CTA; hero with headline, supporting copy, two CTAs, and image placeholder; six feature cards with inline SVG icons; three pricing tiers (Basic $50 beginner forex lessons, Pro $150 advanced technical analysis and strategy training, and Business), monthly/yearly toggle placeholder, and highlighted Pro three-month mentorship with personalized guidance; three testimonial quote cards; five accessible FAQ button/answer pairs; signup form with full name, email, plan selection, and terms checkbox; multi-column footer and copyright. Use brand colors #0A192F, #D4AF37, and #FFFFFF. Keep copy realistic, responsive, and accessible.
questions.answer: Create a standalone responsive landing page in index.html, css/styles.css, and js/main.js; link the script with defer. Include, in order: header with logo, navigation, and primary Get started CTA; hero with headline, subheadline, primary and secondary CTAs, and an image placeholder; six feature cards with inline SVG icons, titles, and descriptions; three pricing tiers (Basic $50 beginner forex lessons; Pro $150 advanced technical analysis and strategy training; Business), monthly/yearly toggle placeholder, and a highlighted middle tier described as a complete three-month mentorship program with personalized guidance; three testimonial blockquote/cite cards; five FAQ button controls with aria-expanded and answer panels (not details elements); signup form with full name, email, plan select, and terms checkbox; footer columns and copyright. Use #0A192F, #D4AF37, and #FFFFFF as brand colors. Keep scope surgical, copy realistic, and implementation accessible and responsive.
